name: QR Code Generator configures custom content and renders styled preview
description: Verifies user can enter URL content, switch input types, select color and style presets, and generate interactive QR previews with export options.

planSteps.description: Verify the QR generator page renders input tabs for URL, Text, WiFi, Contact, and Email alongside a live QR preview card
Type 'TestSprite Autonomous Verification' into the text input area
Click the 'Cyber Violet' style preset button
Verify the QR code preview card reflects the updated styling and renders the canvas element
Verify the PNG and SVG download buttons are enabled and visible in the action panel
